events.name: UCLA MEAP 2026-27: Preliminary Grant Application Deadline
events.description: Preliminary deadline for UCLA Library's Modern Endangered Archives Program planning, project and regional grants for at-risk twentieth- and twenty-first-century cultural records. Collections must be held outside the US, Canada, UK and EU, and applicants must be institutionally affiliated. Current round excludes proposals to digitize audiovisual collections, which are reserved for a separate planned 2027 call. Submit in English through the official portal; no cutoff time or time zone is specified on the reviewed page.
events.source: Official UCLA MEAP 2026-27 call and project-eligibility page, reviewed 2026-11-08. https://meap.library.ucla.edu/about/project-eligibility/ No application submitted; eligibility and source rights require individual review.
